component.name: FADER
component.summary: Per-application volume mixer with profiles and hotkeys

description.p: FADER sets the volume of each application separately, groups applications into profiles, and switches the whole mix with one hotkey.

ul.li: Per-application volume and mute with level meters
Profiles by category (games, chat, music, browsers, system) or by application
LOCK IN: apply a profile and put every level back when you turn it off
